original_manifest.field_policy: null = not explicitly stated in collected official list; no inferred 4-year duration or English teaching
original_manifest.scope: Purdue University official admissions directory for West Lafayette and Indianapolis; each record carries explicit location from its program Quick Facts; excludes other Purdue system institutions
original_manifest.official_published_count: 170 directory cards before excluding exploratory/pre-professional routes; first page displays Showing 170 majors

page_coverage.pagination: GET ?paged=1..11 complete; total 170 unique URLs equals published count; final page10 records. Initial public POST API redirected, so all official GET pages were used instead.

original_manifest.filter_rules: Read Degree and Location(s) in each of 170 program pages. Keep every named bachelor major and split Anthropology BA/BS. Exclude six exploratory/pre-professional/first-year entry routes even where template Degree field says bachelor. Landscape Architecture pre-entry route is attached to the actual major.
original_manifest.completeness_basis: All 170 directory cards reconciled with 170 program Quick Facts pages; excluded non-degree routes have their own raw page evidence.
gaps: This is the official undergraduate admissions directory; it does not independently enumerate every internal second-degree route or optional joint-degree combination unless listed as its own major card.
No claim that an Indianapolis program is physically offered in West Lafayette; campus is explicit per record.
